title: AgentOS Agent Runtime And Ecosystem Chain
objective: Advance AgentOS toward Production Distro by strengthening the Agent Runtime as the OS control plane and adding a local-first ecosystem manager for safe capability expansion.
entry_criteria: Functional iteration final audit is functional-ready.
AgentCore and SecurityExecution boundaries remain accepted.
No normal-mode arbitrary shell is introduced.
Baseline gates remain local-only and do not depend on external LLM, network, Firecracker or host package manager.

waves.name: Chain Freeze And Invariants
waves.purpose: Freeze the unified Agent-operated OS and ecosystem chain before implementation.
exit_criteria: Agent-operated OS lifecycle is defined.
aom install/stage/activate boundary is frozen.
Production Distro acceptance gates are mapped.

waves.name: Agent Runtime OS Control Loops
waves.purpose: Design runtime loops that let AgentOS operate through Agent Runtime rather than ad hoc scripts.
exit_criteria: Boot, steady-state, recovery, update and degraded loops are specified.
Observation fabric and event intake boundaries are defined.
Schedulers and quotas prevent autonomous runaway behavior.

waves.name: Durable Agent Runtime State
waves.purpose: Make Agent Runtime state durable enough for PID 1 operation and long-running distro use.
exit_criteria: PlanRun, audit and recovery truth are reconciled on boot.
Approval and escalation semantics survive restart.
OS memory and knowledge governance cannot poison privileged action.

waves.name: Ecosystem Object Model
waves.purpose: Define AgentOS-native artifact objects and local registry foundations.
exit_criteria: Artifact coordinate, manifest, snapshot, lockfile and activation report schemas are defined.
First artifact kinds are policy-pack, workflow-pack and test-pack.
Trust tier and channel policy are documented.

waves.name: Local-First aom Lifecycle
waves.purpose: Create the local-first ecosystem manager lifecycle before remote registry or public marketplace work.
exit_criteria: aom search/show/verify/stage/explain works against local fixtures.
Staged artifacts are inert.
Digest mismatch, revocation and incompatibility fail closed.

waves.name: Runtime-Mediated Activation
waves.purpose: Connect ecosystem activation to AgentCore and SecurityExecution instead of direct install behavior.
exit_criteria: aom activate produces AgentCore PlanSpec.
Activation side effects go through SecurityExecutionEngine.
agentd projects staged/active/blocked artifacts without owning resolver logic.

waves.name: Safety Replay And Production Gates
waves.purpose: Promote ecosystem and runtime changes only with replay, adversarial fixtures, rollback drills and provenance.
exit_criteria: Ecosystem replay is release-gated.
Adversarial fixtures cover policy weakening, shell bypass, memory poisoning, secret embedding and adapter bypass.
Provenance records registry snapshot, lockfile and replay hashes.

waves.name: Trust And Organization Controls
waves.purpose: Add trust tiers, signing, revocation, organization policy overlays and support visibility for ecosystem artifacts.
exit_criteria: Production Distro can pin channels and reject unsigned artifacts.
Community and local-dev artifacts are sandbox-only or non-promotable by default.
Support bundle can explain active artifact trust state without secrets.

waves.name: Model Knowledge Adapter And Image Packs
waves.purpose: Extend the ecosystem beyond policy/workflow/test packs into model profiles, knowledge, runtime adapters and execution images.
exit_criteria: Model and knowledge packs preserve secret-handle and memory quarantine rules.
Adapter packs cannot bypass SecurityExecutionEngine.
Image packs prove provenance, compatibility and rollback rules before activation.

waves.name: Production Distro Operations
waves.purpose: Turn the runtime and ecosystem chain into long-running production distro operations.
exit_criteria: Support bundle includes runtime and ecosystem state without secrets.
A/B update and rollback readiness include active artifact set.
Long-running recovery and offline mode are validated.
